title: refactor(rope): unify duplicate RoPE implementations into shared module (Phase 2)
body:
## Summary

Phase 2 of #2436 — consolidates duplicate RoPE (Rotary Position Embedding) implementations across **diffusion models** into the shared `vllm_omni/diffusion/layers/rope.py` module.

- Add `apply_rotary_pos_emb()` (LLM-style q,k pair rotation with `position_ids` and MLA support) and `apply_rotary_pos_emb_single()` (single tensor variant) to the shared rope module
- Migrate nextstep_llama from local duplicates to shared import (within `diffusion/`)
- Delete unused `apply_rotary_emb_qwen` dead code from qwen_image
- Add 8 equivalence tests proving bit-exact results vs per-model reference implementations

> **Note:** Per maintainer feedback, `model_executor/models/` should not depend on `diffusion/layers/`. Migrations for omni models (qwen3_tts, mimo_audio) have been reverted. Only diffusion-internal changes remain.

**Net delta: +58 / -67 lines**

## Test plan

- [x] 8 equivalence tests pass (`pytest tests/diffusion/layers/test_rope.py`)
- [x] Tests cover: rotate_half, standard q/k pair, position_ids, MLA reshape, single-tensor, float32/float16
- [x] `ruff check` + `ruff format --check` pass on all changed files
- [ ] CI: pre-commit, build, DCO checks
